svg.aria-label: Jigsaw reading in two steps. Step 1, expert groups: three round tables, each with three students holding papers colour-coded by group, with jigsaw-piece badges — Group 1 (teal) reads paragraphs 1–2 (P1–2), Group 2 (blue) reads paragraphs 3–4 (P3–4), Group 3 (gold) reads paragraphs 5–6 (P5–6). Coloured curved arrows marked “mix!” send one student from each expert group to each new table. Step 2, new mixed groups: two round tables, each with students 1, 2 and 3 — one from each group, holding P1–2, P3–4 and P5–6 — a completed three-piece puzzle on the table and a speech bubble saying “Teach your part!”: each student teaches their part.
svg.title: Jigsaw reading
